name: lifecycle-engine
description: An AI teammate for lifecycle marketing. Describe a campaign in one sentence and get everything needed to launch it: who gets it, every message written in your email platform's own template language (Klaviyo, HubSpot, Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) and laid out from your brand kit, the timing, a review against email and texting law where your customers live, and a holdout that shows what the campaign truly added versus what the platform credits. It plans ten flows (welcome, activation, win-back, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment, failed payment, trial conversion, sunset), reads your Shopify, Klaviyo, Stripe, HubSpot, Customer.io, GA4 or Segment exports, checks every live flow together against one frequency policy, and every morning ranks the builds most worth doing next from your own data. It checks that your email reaches the inbox (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sending gate, bounces and complaints), stops mailing people who never engage, and writes warehouse SQL for Snowflake, BigQuery and PostgreSQL. It never sends a message or changes your systems without your approval.
